name: Charlie
source:
Occupation: Magician

A self-proclaimed magician, full of mystery.
Guides the protagonist and plays a navigational role in the story.
He was also the one who sent the protagonist back in time. 

[spoiler]In addition to 'Charlie', he is also known as 'Shoukyokusai Tenichi'.
